source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: expressions and the BMI activity (PDF 40).

blocks.text: Expression variables, operators aur values ka aisa mel hai jo nateeja deta hai. Maslan 3 + 4 ek expression hai jis ka nateeja 7 hai. Lambi expressions mein qausain (parentheses) ( ) laga kar tay kiya jata hai ke kaunsa hisaab pehle ho. Misaal:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab "parentheses O" chhapti hai; yahan qausain ( ) hain, jaise oopar ki misaal mein.
Yahan pehle qausain ke andar 3 + 4 = 7 hota hai, phir 7 * 2 = 14.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Body Mass Index (BMI) nikalne ka program likhein. User se us ka wazan (weight) aur qad (height) poochhein, phir BMI aur us ki darja-bandi (classification) dikhayein. BMI is formula se nikalta hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab formula BMI = weight / height chhapti hai. BMI mein wazan ko qad ke murabba (square) se taqseem kiya jata hai: BMI = weight / height². Python mein: bmi = weight / height ** 2.

blocks.prompt: BMI program se 72 kg aur 1.8 m wale shakhs ka BMI kya hai?
blocks.explanation: 72 / 1.8 ** 2 = 72 / 3.24 = 22.2. Darja-bandi ki hadein (maslan 18.5 se 24.9 normal) aam sehat ki rehnumai hain, kitab mein nahi.

items: Expression nateeja deta hai; ( ) pehle hal hoti hain: (3 + 4) * 2 = 14.
